# Priscilla Grant

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Island  <sub>[v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with ethereal, golden beauty. On occasion, she presents a striking appearance wearing silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Though appearing pale and spiritual, Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious. She is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun, and enjoys playing playful jokes alongside her friends. She also harbours a strong desire for fame.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012)_

## History

Priscilla Grant studied at Queen's Academy, where she formed a close circle of friends with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. She later worked as a schoolteacher, securing the Carmody school before taking her home school instead. During her time in Avonlea, she engaged with the local Avonlea Village Improvement Society and presented a paper on cemeteries. Later, she obtained her father's consent to attend Redmond College, where she and Anne boarded together and shared social life alongside Philippa Gordon and Stella Maynard at Patty's Place. While studying at Redmond, she focused her studies on classics. Following her graduation, Priscilla married a handsome, well-dressed foreign missionary and moved with him to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_
